Q: Abaqus CAE Python scripting, what documentation is available A:

In the official documentation of Abaqus you can find all what you need to create and edit your custom Python scripts in the following sections:

  • Scripting: general overview about the Python API in Abaqus, tree structure, collections...

  • Scripting Reference: classic documentation with the whole list of classes and methods specifying the arguments, outputs, exceptions, etc.

My recommendation is that you take the rpy or jnl files as the starting point. Then, edit them according to the customization or parameterization that you are looking for and use the documentation as required (most often for debugging).

To access the official documentation you need to register: https://help.3ds.com/2026/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMULIA_Established_FrontmatterMap/sim-t-SIMULIA_EstablishedDocSearchOnline.htm?contextscope=all

Q: INNER JOINing on a LEFT JOINed table does not include all rows with CodeIgniter query builder script A:

two tips:

1st: both option and product_option tables needs left join

2nd: certainly IFNULL() needs an alias to call

$this->db->select('IFNULL(`option`.`optionValue`, "Not Set") AS optionValue', FALSE)
   ->from('category_optiongroup')
   ->join('product_option', 'product_option.productId='.$productId
            .' AND product_option.optionGroupId=category_optiongroup.optionGroupId', 'left')
   ->join('option', 'option.id=product_option.optionId', 'left')
   ->where('categoryId', $data['categoryId'])
   ->order_by('category_optiongroup.inOrder', 'ASC');
$query = $this->db->get();
return $query;

Q: Add information from response in HTML component A:

1 : Start by checking <p>Total students: {{ alunos.length }}</p>

Does it actually show 5? This one line tells you a lot :

  • If it shows 5, your binding and change detection are working fine, so the issue is isolated to the *ngFor loop or the property names inside each aluno object (see #2).

  • If it shows 0 or nothing, something more fundamental is going on (wrong component being rendered, stale template, etc.)

2 : Property casing mismatch

If your backend is .NET/C#, it likely serializes JSON in PascalCase (Nome, Emal, Cpf) by default, while your Angular model/template expects camelCase (aluno.nome). That would explain exactly what you're seeing: the array exists, length is correct, but aluno.nome is undefined, so each <tr> renders with empty <td>s — which just looks like nothing is showing up.

To check: open DevTools → Elements tab (not Console) and see if the <tr>s are actually there with emptu cells. Also worth peeking at Network -> Response on that request to see the real casing of the keys coming back.

3 : Hidden CSS rule

Worth a quick look too — a stray display: none, height: 0, or an inherited overflow: hidden in alunos.css can hide a perfectly populated table without you noticing.

4 : Stale build

Less likely, but do a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) or restart ng serve just in case you're staring at a cached template.

Anyway, I think it's No 2.

Q: Using concatenation-assignment operator on array data in a loop displays "ArrayArrayArray" A:

The problem is that your $layout_array is a String , because you're using .= (concatenating).

Instead of:

$layout_array .= array(array("cellID" => '"'. $_POST['ce...

Do:

$layout_array[] = array(array("cellID" => '"'. $_POST['ce....

And change the next line as well:

$layout_array .= array(array("cellID" => "null","studentID" => "null"));

BTW , why not using serialize and unserialize instead of json encoding?

EDIT: For your comfort , links to the php manual of the functions I've suggested.

http://php.net/manual/en/function.serialize.php

http://php.net/manual/en/function.unserialize.php

Q: Error: WebSocket was closed before the connection was established A:

It happens when you call close() on websocket when connection is not established. The code you include in the question does not include a close(); check for a close(), and make sure you don't call it if connection is not established.

discord.js uses ws, this is the place error is thrown:

https://github.com/websockets/ws/blob/a2c0d447af711ca245cb534159fa7c4d9ae67e64/lib/websocket.js#L222

so if websocket is in CONNECTING state and you call close() the error is thrown.

References: https://stackoverflow.com/a/12503628/9483495

Q: How to execute a long CURL command on zsh on mac terminal? A:

Try this instead:

curl -v -w"%{http_code}\n" --stdout=/tmp/curl_out --stderr=/tmp/curl_err \
-u "user@password" 'https://yoursite.yourdomain.com/api/query' \
--data-urlencode 'param1=value 1' \
--data-urlencode 'param2=value 2' | jq .
